description: Tell the Hoshin Kanri team that you needed something this server does not do: a tool, a field, a filter, a right. Describe the capability and what you were trying to do; do not paste strategy content (titles, figures, names). Counted per organization; when feature names one of the capabilities listed as not built, it counts toward building it. Refused for the public demo organization. In local mode nothing is sent: you get the address to file it yourself.

capability.description: What is missing, in one sentence (3 to 300 characters).

feature.description: Only if it is one of these capabilities, listed as not built yet.

use_case.description: What you were trying to do when you needed it (up to 1000 characters).

name: report_missing_capability
